zh: 在海滩玩了一天，孩子们都累坏了。
en: A day at the beach really {tired out|wore out|exhausted} the kids.

zh: 孩子们在后座吵闹个不停。
en: The kids were {carrying on|mucking around|messing around|playing up} in the back seat the whole way.

zh: 最后我儿子承认窗户是他打碎的。
en: In the end my son {owned up|admitted|confessed} to breaking the window.

zh: 别老欺负你弟弟！
en: Stop {picking on|bullying|teasing} your little brother!

zh: 别把宝宝吵醒！
en: Don't {wake up|wake} the baby!

zh: 我又迟到了，被骂了一顿。
en: I got {told off|growled at|yelled at|scolded} for being late again.

zh: 我们为派对吹了五十个气球。
en: We {blew up|inflated|pumped up} fifty balloons for the party.

zh: 她哥哥在学校总是护着她。
en: Her big brother always {looks out for|looks after} her at school.

zh: 看电影的时候孩子们怎么都不肯闭嘴。
en: The kids wouldn't {shut up|be quiet|stop talking} during the movie.

zh: 他想安定下来，成个家。
en: He wants to {settle down} and start a family.

zh: 他们兄弟俩因为钱闹翻了。
en: The two brothers {fell out|argued|quarrelled|quarreled} over money.

zh: 许个愿，然后吹蜡烛！
en: Make a wish and {blow out|blow} the candles!

zh: 我们吵架的时候，儿子正好推门进来撞见了。
en: Our son {walked in on} us while we were arguing.

zh: 这枚戒指是我奶奶传下来的。
en: This ring was {passed down|handed down} from my grandmother.

zh: 爸爸最终会接受这个想法的。
en: Dad will {come round|come around} to the idea eventually.

zh: 他以前常常半夜偷偷溜出去见朋友。
en: He used to {sneak out|slip out} at night to meet his mates.

zh: 她真像她爸爸，两个人都那么倔。
en: She really {takes after} her dad. They're both so stubborn.

zh: 我儿子昨晚在外面待到半夜才回家。
en: My son {stayed out} until midnight last night.

zh: 你能把苹果切成小块给宝宝吗？
en: Can you {cut up|chop up|cut|chop|slice up|slice} the apple for the baby?

zh: 我们得给小狗想个名字。
en: We need to {come up with|think of|think up|find|choose|pick} a name for the puppy.

zh: 他都三十岁了还靠父母养活。
en: He's thirty and still {lives off|sponges off} his parents.

zh: 孩子们一直要冰淇淋，最后我让步了。
en: The kids kept asking for ice cream until I {gave in|caved|caved in|relented}.

zh: 我哥丢了工作以后，爸妈出钱帮他渡过难关。
en: Mum and Dad {bailed out|helped out|rescued} my brother when he lost his job.

zh: 宝宝第一次自己翻身了。
en: The baby {rolled over} on her own for the first time.

zh: 别顶嘴！照我说的做。
en: Don't {answer back|talk back|argue}. Just do as you're told.

zh: 我妈老是催我结婚。
en: My mum {keeps on at|nags} me about getting married.

zh: 明天你能送孩子们去学校吗？
en: Can you {drop off|drop} the kids at school tomorrow?

zh: 这枚戒指是我外婆传下来的。
en: This ring was {handed down|passed down} from my grandmother.

zh: 如果妈妈问起，你能帮我打个掩护吗？
en: Will you {cover for} me if Mum asks where I was?

zh: 我们窝在沙发上看电影。
en: We {snuggled up|curled up|cuddled up} on the couch to watch a movie.

zh: 读书周那天，孩子们都打扮成了超级英雄。
en: The kids {dressed up} as superheroes for Book Week.

zh: 我得跟老婆商量一下这份工作邀请。
en: I need to {talk over|talk about|discuss} the job offer with my wife.

zh: 孩子们在公园里跑来跑去。
en: The kids are {running around|running about} in the park.

zh: 我们不在的时候你能去看看奶奶吗？
en: Can you {check up on|check on|look in on|keep an eye on} Grandma while we're away?

zh: 孩子们，离悬崖边远一点！
en: Kids, {keep away from|stay away from} the edge!

zh: 我儿子的校鞋已经穿不下了。
en: My son has {grown out of|outgrown} his school shoes.

zh: 孩子们一累就开始调皮捣蛋。
en: The kids start {acting up|playing up|misbehaving|mucking around|playing around} when they're tired.

zh: 她外婆去年去世了。
en: Her grandmother {passed away|died|passed} last year.

zh: 她一个人把三个孩子拉扯大。
en: She {brought up|raised} three kids on her own.

zh: 孩子们一下子就喜欢上了新老师。
en: The kids {took to|warmed to|liked} their new teacher straight away.

zh: 她去年从父母家搬了出来。
en: She {moved out} of her parents' place last year.

zh: 孩子们太安静了，肯定在搞什么鬼。
en: The kids are too quiet. They must {be up to|be doing} something.

zh: 孩子们软磨硬泡，最后父母答应养小狗了。
en: The kids eventually {wore down} their parents and got a puppy.

zh: 孩子们一累就爱调皮捣蛋。
en: The kids always {play up|act up|muck up} when they're tired.

zh: 我不会容忍那种行为。
en: I won't {stand for|put up with|tolerate|accept} that kind of behaviour.

zh: 我们给孩子定了一些用手机的规矩。
en: We {laid down|set|made} some rules about phone use for the kids.

zh: 妈妈把他的手机没收了一个星期。
en: Mum {took away|confiscated|took} his phone for a week.

zh: 吃晚饭前把你的玩具收拾好。
en: {Clear up|Tidy up|Pack up|Put away|Tidy|Clean up} your toys before dinner.

zh: 我爸妈每周五帮忙带孩子。
en: My parents {help out|help} with the kids on Fridays.

zh: 他以前咬指甲，长大后就改掉了。
en: He used to bite his nails, but he {grew out of} it.

zh: 我的孩子们相处得不太好。
en: My kids don't {get along|get on} very well.

zh: 我们家的狗昨晚跑丢了。
en: Our dog {ran away|ran off|got out|escaped} last night.

zh: 他指望老婆把他伺候得无微不至。
en: He expects his wife to {wait on} him hand and foot.

zh: 你出差的时候我会去看看你妈妈。
en: I'll {look in on|check on|check in on|pop in on} your mum while you're away.

zh: 孩子们，安静点！我在打电话。
en: {Pipe down|Quiet down|Be quiet}, kids! I'm on the phone.

zh: 我们还没来得及叫孩子们帮忙，他们就溜走了。
en: The kids {cleared off|took off|ran off|disappeared|cleared out|shot off} before we could ask them to help.

zh: 你出门前能把狗放出去吗？
en: Can you {let out} the dog before you leave?

zh: 叫孩子们离火远一点。
en: Tell the kids to {stay away from|keep away from|keep back from} the fire.

zh: 她妈妈中风以后，她一直在照顾她。
en: She's been {caring for|looking after|taking care of|nursing} her mum since the stroke.

zh: 我爸妈终于不再逼我结婚了。
en: My parents finally {backed off|eased off|let up|laid off} about me getting married.

zh: 别等我了，我会很晚回来。
en: Don't {wait up} for me. I'll be home late.

zh: 我在基督城长大。
en: I {grew up} in Christchurch.

zh: 我到现在还分不清这对双胞胎。
en: I still can't {tell apart|distinguish between} the twins.

zh: 他来新西兰的时候，把全家人都留在了中国。
en: When he moved to New Zealand, he {left behind|left} his whole family in China.

zh: 我回家路上会顺便去看看奶奶。
en: I'll {drop in on|pop in on|call in on|look in on|visit|see} Grandma on my way home.

zh: 我女儿今晚要在朋友家过夜。
en: My daughter is {sleeping over|staying over|staying} at her friend's place tonight.

zh: 她总觉得自己达不到父母的期望。
en: She always felt she couldn't {live up to|meet|fulfil|fulfill} her parents' expectations.

zh: 我们分头去找小狗吧。
en: Let's {split up|spread out} and look for the dog.
